# Local AI Registry

> Local AI Registry gets local businesses recommended when people ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI where to go. It publishes original research on how AI assistants choose local businesses, free guides for owners, and a public registry of business records.

Every page below is also available as Markdown: add index.md to its URL. The whole site in one file is at https://localairegistry.com/llms-full.txt.
Contact: hello@localairegistry.com · (213) 931-5633 · 9891 Irvine Center Dr, Irvine, CA 92618

## Get recommended by AI: the pillar guide, assistants and signals

- [Where each AI assistant gets its local business information](https://localairegistry.com/ai/): How ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, Siri, Alexa, Meta AI and Grok choose which local businesses to recommend.
- [How do I get my business recommended by Alexa?](https://localairegistry.com/ai/alexa/): Alexa answers local questions from partner data and the web. Accurate listings on the major directories and review sites, especially the ones that feed voi.
- [How do I get my business recommended by ChatGPT?](https://localairegistry.com/ai/chatgpt/): Claim your business in ChatGPT's Business Hub and make sure OpenAI's search crawler, OAI-SearchBot, can read your website.
- [How do I get my business recommended by Claude?](https://localairegistry.com/ai/claude/): When Claude searches the web for a local question, it reads and cites public sources: review sites, guides, news and business websites.
- [How do I get my business to show up in Microsoft Copilot?](https://localairegistry.com/ai/copilot/): Copilot draws on Bing search, so an accurate Bing Places listing, consistent directory details, reviews and a website that ranks in Bing are the foundation.
- [How do I get my business recommended by Gemini?](https://localairegistry.com/ai/gemini/): Gemini can draw on Google Search and Google Maps, so the businesses it recommends usually have complete Google Business Profiles, strong recent reviews and.
- [How do I get my business into Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode?](https://localairegistry.com/ai/google-ai-overviews/): Google's AI answers are built on Google Search and Google's local data.
- [How do I get my business to show up in Grok?](https://localairegistry.com/ai/grok/): Grok, xAI's assistant inside X, searches the web and posts on X. The same web signals that help other assistants apply, plus an active, accurate presence o.
- [How do I get my business to show up in Meta AI?](https://localairegistry.com/ai/meta-ai/): Meta AI lives inside Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger and can search the web for local questions.
- [How do I get my business to show up in Perplexity?](https://localairegistry.com/ai/perplexity/): Perplexity searches the web for every answer and shows its sources. Being on the review sites, local guides and articles it cites, with consistent details.
- [How do I get my business to show up in Siri and Apple Maps?](https://localairegistry.com/ai/siri/): When someone asks Siri for a nearby business, Apple draws on Apple Maps data.
- [Local AI search glossary](https://localairegistry.com/glossary/): Plain-language definitions of GEO, AEO, AI Overviews, entities, schema markup, llms.txt, AI Score and other local AI search terms.
- [How to get your local business recommended by AI](https://localairegistry.com/guide/): How to get your local business recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI: how assistants decide, the 8 steps in order, and the 11 signals behind every.
- [The AI visibility checklist for local businesses](https://localairegistry.com/guide/checklist/): A one-page checklist to get your local business recommended by AI: facts, Google profile, reviews, website, outside proof, media and monthly monitoring.
- [How to claim your business in ChatGPT](https://localairegistry.com/guide/claim-your-business-in-chatgpt/): Step by step: how to claim and verify your business in ChatGPT's Business Hub, what it changes, what it doesn't, and five things to check first.
- [Why doesn't ChatGPT recommend my business?](https://localairegistry.com/guide/not-showing-up/): The seven most common reasons ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI don't recommend a local business, and how to find and fix yours.
- [The 11 signals AI checks before it recommends a local business](https://localairegistry.com/signals/): The eleven signals ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI use to decide which local business to recommend, with a guide to checking and fixing each one.
- [How do I know what AI says about my business?](https://localairegistry.com/signals/ai-monitoring/): Ask it, regularly and the same way each time. Run the questions your customers ask across ChatGPT, Gemini, Google's AI answers, Perplexity and others every.
- [Do best-of lists affect which business AI recommends?](https://localairegistry.com/signals/best-of-guides/): Often, yes. When someone asks an assistant for "the best" business of a type in a city, it frequently reads local best-of lists and guides to answer.
- [Why do directory listings matter for AI recommendations?](https://localairegistry.com/signals/directory-listings/): AI assistants compare what different websites say about your business.
- [Does my Google Business Profile affect AI recommendations?](https://localairegistry.com/signals/google-profile/): Yes, heavily for Google's own AI answers and Gemini, which draw on Google's local data, and indirectly for other assistants that read Google results.
- [Can AI understand the photos of my business?](https://localairegistry.com/signals/photo-codifying/): Partly. AI can now describe images, but it reads the text around a photo more reliably: the file name, alt text, caption and the page it sits on.
- [Does press coverage help a local business get recommended by AI?](https://localairegistry.com/signals/pr/): Yes. AI assistants trust independent sources more than a business's own website.
- [How do reviews affect whether AI recommends my business?](https://localairegistry.com/signals/reputation/): Reviews are one of the main things assistants use to decide who to recommend.
- [Is SEO still needed if customers use AI instead of Google?](https://localairegistry.com/signals/seo/): Yes. Many assistants search the web before they answer, and they lean on the pages that already rank well.
- [Why do articles on other websites matter for AI visibility?](https://localairegistry.com/signals/third-party-articles/): Assistants trust what independent sites say about you more than what you say about yourself.
- [Does video help my business show up in AI answers?](https://localairegistry.com/signals/video/): Video helps in two ways. Assistants that search the web can read video titles, descriptions and transcripts, and YouTube results often appear in Google's A.
- [What does my website need so AI can understand it?](https://localairegistry.com/signals/web-management/): Your site needs to load fast, work on a phone, state plainly what you do and where, and include structured data (schema) that labels your business, service.

## Original research and news

- [Same question. Different answer.](https://localairegistry.com/answer-watch/): We asked ChatGPT the same question six times in 10 cities and screenshotted every answer. Dated, unedited receipts of who AI recommends, and how often.
- [What Is an AI Score, and How Is It Calculated?](https://localairegistry.com/journal/what-is-an-ai-score/): The AI Score is a 0 to 100 measure of how findable and recommendable a local business is to AI assistants, built from eight published signals.
- [Methodology: How the AI Score Is Built](https://localairegistry.com/methodology/): Eight signals, one number from 0 to 100. The heaviest is whether AI can retrieve you at all. Every input, weight, formula, and source, documented.
- [The Local AI Registry Journal.](https://localairegistry.com/news/): Stories about local businesses, best-of guides built on public data, and what Local AI Registry's research team finds when it asks AI where to go.
- [The $199 Botox studio on Newport Boulevard](https://localairegistry.com/news/the-199-botox-studio-on-newport-boulevard/): QUIKTOX, a surgeon-led Costa Mesa studio, charges one flat $199 price for Botox in a city that charges by the unit. Who it's for, how it compares, and everything you need before you book.
- [The Convergence](https://localairegistry.com/proof/the-convergence-white-paper/): White Paper 03 from Local AI Registry Research reads eleven independent streams of evidence on how local businesses get recommended by AI, explained twice.
- [How AI sends customers through the door](https://localairegistry.com/research/): Original AEO research from Local AI Registry on how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity find and recommend local businesses.
- [How Often AI Recommends Your Business](https://localairegistry.com/research/how-often-ai-recommends-your-business/): Local AI Registry reviews 14 sources: ask AI the same thing twice and Gemini’s sources overlap by only 0.46. How to measure how often AI recommends you.
- [The Local Answer Gap: what 7,583 Google AI answers reveal about AEO for local businesses](https://localairegistry.com/research/local-answer-gap/): Local AI Registry’s AEO study of 7,583 Google AI answers: news supplied 67.5% of local citations, business sites 6.5%. Charts, data and an AEO playbook.
- [Local AI search statistics, 2026](https://localairegistry.com/statistics/): Local AI search statistics for 2026: how often AI names local businesses, where AI gets its answers and how answers change, each figure linked to its source.
